FROM customer_total_return AS ctr1
JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ON customer.c_current_addr_sk = customer_address.ca_address_sk
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT avg_total_return
    FROM (
        SELECT AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_total_return
        FROM customer_total_return AS ctr2
        WHERE ctr2.ctr_state = ctr1.ctr_state
    ) AS avg_subquery
) AS avg_row(avg_total_return)
WHERE customer_address.ca_state = 'TN'
    AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > avg_row.avg_total_return
ORDER BY c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_street_type, ca_suite_number, ca_city, ca_county, ca_state, ca_zip, ca_country, ca_gmt_offset, ca_location_type, ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100
